I had no idea what Ghost was about before diving into this album. I've heard they are a more esoteric and eccentric type of metal which immediately intrigued me. I am always a fan of something a little out there and a little weird. For me the weirder and album is the better because I feel like there is this barrier to entry that other more palatable albums don't have and you tend to get a lot of people enjoying it. In other words I am a pretentious douche at times. Though I never try to judge an album before I hear the music within. By god was I disappointed in Ghost. First, I like my metal hard hitting and dark. The vocal performance was so up front and clean and bright that I immediately kind of scrunched up my face because I was uncomfortable. I was immediately reminded of any number of prog bands that took notes from Rush. Once I got a few more songs into the album it hit me that this band sounds almost exactly like Spock's Beard. Minus the more overdriven and distorted guitar sounds at times the only thing that would make this a Spock's Beard cover band for me would be more virtuous solos and some heavily layered vocal melodies. I just couldn't get passed the gaudy nature of the whole album and the very 70's era theater metal that is more about the costumes than it is the heaviness of the music a la Kiss.

I don't know if I'm missing anything here but I just can't get into them or their sound. What do ya'll think?
